description: This file contains the implementation of utility functions used in PhpSpreadsheet calculations, including compatibility settings, data type checks, error handling, and array flattening methods.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various calculation-related functionalities in PhpSpreadsheet, such as data validation, error handling, array utilities, and configuration settings.

methods.name: setCompatibilityMode
methods.description: Sets the calculation compatibility mode (Excel, Gnumeric, OpenOffice).

methods.name: getCompatibilityMode
methods.description: Returns the current calculation compatibility mode.

methods.name: setReturnDateType
methods.description: Sets the format for returning date values (Unix timestamp, PHP DateTime object, Excel serial).

methods.name: getReturnDateType
methods.description: Retrieves the current date return format.

methods.name: DUMMY
methods.description: A placeholder method returning a #Not Yet Implemented string.

methods.name: isMatrixValue
methods.description: Checks if a given index indicates a matrix cell based on dot notation and pattern.

methods.name: isValue
methods.description: Checks if an index indicates a simple value without dots.

methods.name: isCellValue
methods.description: Checks if an index indicates a cell value (more than one dot).

methods.name: ifCondition
methods.description: Builds a conditional expression string based on input, handling various data types.

methods.name: operandSpecialHandling
methods.description: Handles special operand cases such as percentages, dates, booleans, and numbers.

methods.name: null
methods.description: Returns the #NULL! error symbol.

methods.name: NAN
methods.description: Returns the #NUM! error symbol.

methods.name: REF
methods.description: Returns the #REF! error symbol.

methods.name: NA
methods.description: Returns the #N/A error symbol.

methods.name: VALUE
methods.description: Returns the #VALUE! error symbol.

methods.name: NAME
methods.description: Returns the #NAME? error symbol.

methods.name: DIV0
methods.description: Returns the division by zero error symbol.

methods.name: errorType
methods.description: Returns the type of a value as a symbol or code.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a value is blank.

methods.name: isErr
methods.description: Checks if a value is any kind of error.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a value is any error (alias or similar to isErr).

methods.name: isNa
methods.description: Checks if a value is the #N/A error.

methods.name: isEven
methods.description: Checks if a number is even.

methods.name: isOdd
methods.description: Checks if a number is odd.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is numeric.

methods.name: isLogical
methods.description: Checks if a value is boolean logical.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Checks if a value is text.

methods.name: isNonText
methods.description: Checks if a value is non-text.

methods.name: n
methods.description: Converts a value to a number, handling dates, booleans, errors.

methods.name: TYPE
methods.description: Returns a number indicating the type of a value (numeric, text, logical, error, array).

methods.name: flattenArray
methods.description: Flattens a multi-dimensional array into a single-dimensional array.

methods.name: scalar
methods.description: Extracts a single value from an array.

methods.name: flattenArrayIndexed
methods.description: Flattens a multi-dimensional array into a single array with indexed keys reflecting hierarchy.

methods.name: flattenSingleValue
methods.description: Converts nested arrays into a scalar with the first element.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Checks if a cell reference or string is a formula.

methods.name: expandDefinedName
methods.description: Expands a named range or defined name into a cell reference string.

methods.name: trimTrailingRange
methods.description: Removes the trailing range part from a cell coordinate.

methods.name: trimSheetFromCellReference
methods.description: Removes sheet name prefix from a cell reference.
